basic_info.main_problem: 我对失败有强烈的厌恶，因为我认为这反映了我的not安全感以及我对他人看法的过度在意。这种对失败和被负面看待的恐惧在我一生中反复出现，尤其在竞争性情境中加剧，并导致Anxiety、自尊受影响与回避可能失败的挑战。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为对失败的恐惧和对外部认可的需要阻碍了我的个人与Career development，我希望处理这些潜在的not安全感。
growth_experiences: In primary school, I lost in a game once and subjectively felt 'everyone is judging me'; since then, in competitive and evaluation situations I persistently feel stress, needing to maintain others' positive views of me by winning; I gradually formed avoidance of scenes where failure is possible and afterwards fall into regret and self-loathing.
原生家庭事件：2岁时父亲去世。尽管具体互动细节Not mentioned，但该早期丧亲可能与其内在not安全感及对他人认可的敏感度有关。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to participate in competitions at work or facing external performance evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Participating means exposing shortcomings and being looked down on (viewing others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静但坚定的语气强调时间与优先级、成本与收益not对等等理由，说明参与“not值得/not现实”，从而避免进入竞争情境。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests low-risk behavioral experiments or gradual contact
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: This will push me toward failure and others' negative evaluations (others' judgments are exaggerated and externally attributed)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Defensive tone, emphasizes sentence patterns such as 'they will think...', treating possible external evaluations as established facts to refuse trying.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling childhood experiences of losing games and feeling judged
